instruction: Candid action photograph, eye-level medium shot. Inside an indoor judo dojo with a yellow tatami mat, the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) and the young man in the white judo gi (R2) are standing and grappling. Positioned on the left, the woman (R1) grips his collar, while the young man (R2) on the right holds her sleeve, both locked in a focused judo stance. Natural light streams from the windows in the background, casting soft shadows across the neutral-toned training room.
